subject: Linguagens e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Analisar e experimentar diversos processos de remidiação de produções multissemióticas, multimídia e transmídia, desenvolvendo diferentes modos de participação e intervenção social.

components.description_pt: Identificar processos de remediação em produções multissemióticas e multimídia
components.description_en: Identify remediation processes across multisemiotic and multimedia productions
components.cc_component_description: Identify differences in how a text and its multimedia version portray the same subject

components.description_pt: Analisar como produções transmídia transformam significado em diferentes plataformas
components.description_en: Analyze how transmedia productions transform meaning across different platforms
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate how an American dramatist's work is interpreted across multiple versions or productions

components.description_pt: Avaliar possibilidades de participação social criadas por produções multissemióticas
components.description_en: Evaluate the social participation possibilities created by multisemiotic productions

components.description_pt: Experimentar criar ou adaptar conteúdo em diferentes mídias e modos semióticos
components.description_en: Experiment with creating or adapting content across different media and semiotic modes
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the artistic choices an author makes when adapting or departing from source material

cc_matches.description: Compare and contrast a text to an audio, video, or multimedia version of the text, analyzing each medium's portrayal of the subject (e.g., how the delivery of a speech affects the impact of the words).

Analyze multiple interpretations of a story, drama, or poem (e.g., recorded or live production of a play or recorded novel or poetry), evaluating how each version interprets the source text. (Include at least one play by Shakespeare and one play by an American dramatist.)

Analyze how an author draws on and transforms source material in a specific work (e.g., how Shakespeare treats a theme or topic from Ovid or the Bible or how a later author draws on a play by Shakespeare).
